Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green and white finish and metal and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details

5063536260008.baseName: Height Lighting Tabletop Artificial Christmas Tree with Rustic Log Base Plain 60cm
5063536260008.variantName: Height Lighting Tabletop Artificial Christmas Tree with Rustic Log Base Plain 60cm
5063536260008.sourceDescription:
Not every room has space for a full-size tree, but every room deserves a bit of Christmas. This little tabletop tree brings all the festive feeling to a sideboard, desk or bedside table, with lush green branches sitting on a rustic log base that gives it a cosy, natural look.

It comes in two heights, 45cm or 60cm, so you can pick the size that fits your space. The branches are full and bushy and can be bent and fluffed out to shape, and the bark-edged log base keeps it steady wherever you put it.

You can also choose whether you want it plain or with warm white LED lights already wrapped through the branches. The lit version glows beautifully in the evening, just like candlelight, and runs on 3 x AAA batteries, which aren’t included, so there are no wires to hide. The plain version is perfect for decorating your own way with mini baubles, ribbon or a little star on top.

It’s lovely on a mantelpiece, windowsill, kitchen worktop or office desk, or in a bedroom, flat or anywhere short on space. Pop a couple of different sizes together for a mini festive forest, and keep it out right through the season.
Small tree height: 45cm
Large tree height: 60cm
Base: Log with bark edge
Lit tree lights: Warm white LED
Lit tree batteries: 3 x AAA (not included)

What is oxo-biodegradable plastic?
Oxo-biodegradable plastic is ordinary plastic to which small amounts of metal salts (a prodegradant additive) has been added during the manufacturing process. The resulting plastic is then made into products like carrier bags, produce or courier bags, straws and other short-life/single-use items. The big difference between oxo-biodegradable and ordinary plastic is that if oxo-biodegradable plastic escapes collection and ends up in the open environment as litter, it will degrade and biodegrade in a similar way to nature’s waste.

How does it work?
In the presence of oxygen, the prodegradant additive breaks the molecular chains in the polymer, and at the end of its useful life the product will degrade and biodegrade, that is it will be consumed by bacteria and fungi, after the additive has reduced the molecular weight to a level which permits them access to the carbon and hydrogen.

32pcs brown flocked Christmas ornaments set, 5 mixed shapes. Soft matte velvety surface, classic rustic style. Shatterproof plastic, ready to hang.

6 x Christmas Wooden Ornament Base Plates

EASY DIY STEPS

Open the package and check all tools and drill gems.

Match the symbol codes on the wooden ornament plate with the corresponding diamond color bags.

Apply a small amount of wax mud into the tip of the drill pen.

Pick up each resin gem using the pen and press it onto its matching symbol on the wooden plate.

Relaxing & Beginner Friendly: Simple follow-by-number design makes this kit ideal for beginners, experienced crafters, family bonding time, and seasonal DIY projects.

5037204458608.sourceDescription:
Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Snowflake Detail
Snowflake detailing adds a winter themed accent to the design. The pattern can be used alongside simpler decorations to vary the visual texture of a seasonal arrangement while keeping the display within a coordinated festive theme.

Hanging Cord
The hanging cord gives the ornament a defined attachment point for a suitable support. It allows the decorative face to remain visible and makes it easy to include the piece among other hanging accents in the intended display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Product details
Material: Wood. Stated size: 19 x 22 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Features a classic Father Christmas motif with delicate snowflake detailing for festive charm.
Crafted from wood with a hanging cord, making it easy to display as a home ornament.
Compact size of 19 x 22 cm allows it to fit seamlessly into any seasonal arrangement.
Adds a recognisable focal point to your Christmas display when paired with other decorations.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Included: Hanging cord
Hanger included

Christmas Tree Skirt
This Christmas tree skirt adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red finish and fabric construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Snowflake Detail
Snowflake detailing adds a winter themed accent to the design. The pattern can be used alongside simpler decorations to vary the visual texture of a seasonal arrangement while keeping the display within a coordinated festive theme.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details

Generous 90 cm diameter size provides a substantial base cover for your tree.

3622392484908.sourceDescription:
Metal Christmas Tree Base for 2.80M Trees
This heavy-duty metal Christmas tree base is engineered to securely support trees up to 2.80 meters tall, blending uncompromising stability with festive style—ideal for keeping your large holiday tree upright while enhancing your home’s holiday decor.
1. Core Specifications & Design
Support Capacity: Specifically built for 2.80m Christmas trees (artificial or real). It handles the tree’s weight plus heavy decorations (ornaments, garlands, lights) without tipping, even in high-traffic areas.
Material: Premium sturdy metal. The thick, corrosion-resistant metal construction resists bending or warping, ensuring long-term durability for yearly holiday use.
Festive Appeal: Designed with subtle decorative details (e.g., sleek metallic finish, curved edges, or subtle embossing). It avoids the "industrial" look of plain supports, complementing rather than clashing with your festive setup.
2. Key Advantages (Function + Style)
Maximum Stability: Wide, weighted base or reinforced tripod structure (depending on design) lowers the center of gravity. This prevents the tree from leaning or falling—critical for homes with kids, pets, or frequent guests.
2-in-1 Utility: Acts as both a functional support and a decor accent. Its polished metal finish (often available in gold, silver, or black) adds a touch of elegance to the tree base, making it a cohesive part of your holiday display.
Easy Compatibility: Fits most standard 2.80m tree trunks. It includes adjustable clamps or a central sleeve to secure the trunk tightly, eliminating gaps that cause wobbling.
3. User-Friendly Details
Simple Assembly: No complex tools required. Most styles come with pre-attached parts or clear instructions—unfold the base, secure the trunk, and it’s ready to use in minutes.
Space-Efficient: Compact enough to fit under the tree without blocking gifts or decor. Its low-profile design stays hidden enough to keep focus on the tree, while still being sturdy.

5096042276508.baseName: Christmas wreath - Festive door decoration - Blue spruce-style foliage, 10 cm deep for a festive entrance - Blue-green, 35 cm
5096042276508.variantName: Christmas wreath - Festive door decoration - Blue spruce-style foliage, 10 cm deep for a festive entrance - Blue-green, 35 cm
5096042276508.sourceDescription:
The blue-green colour recreates the cooler tone of blue spruce. With a 35 cm span and a depth of about 10 cm, the ring has a full profile that works alone or as a base for decorations in your own colours.

A wreath puts the decoration on the door or wall itself, leaving the console or mantelpiece below free for cards and winter flowers. Its outline is complete in one piece, which is handy in an entrance where there is little space for a tree. For a simpler finish, keep additional decorations to one part of the ring and let the natural shape of the foliage show elsewhere. A ribbon tied off-centre can pick up a colour from the tree without covering the sprigs.

When dressing an entrance, allow for the full movement of the door as well as the width of the decoration. Set it clear of the handle, letter plate and frame so the arrangement stays in position as people come and go. A simple way to plan the setting is to mark the centre of the intended space with a small piece of paper. Hold the decoration over it, then step back to see how it sits alongside the door surround or other wall decorations.

Hung on a panelled door, a wreath looks best when the edges of the panel still show. Centre it on the panel itself and look at it from the far end of the hall before choosing the final hanging height. A plain background lets you see the smaller details even from the other side of the room. Try holding the wreath against a light wall and then against a darker door before fixing the hanging point.

A narrow ribbon in a colour taken from the design makes a discreet finishing touch if you use your own hanger. Varying the length of the ribbon lets you line up the centre of the wreath with a panel or a nearby mirror. If you plan to use the wreath in a group, set it out with your other decorations before you hang them.
Festive blue-green wreath with realistic blue spruce-style foliage for a traditional Christmas look.
Compact 35 cm diameter design with 10 cm depth, perfect for doors or walls without taking up space.
Durable plastic construction ensures long-lasting colour and shape for repeated seasonal use.
Versatile decoration that works alone or as a base for your own ribbons and ornaments.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

5056214088308.variantName: YouGarden Woodland Wreath With Cones and White Berries, 30cm Christmas Door Decoration, Ready To Display
5056214088308.sourceDescription:
Create a natural-look, inviting festive welcome to your home with this 30cm Woodland Wreath.

The wreath features a decorative mix of pinecones, white berries, wooden stars and woodland-style foliage, giving it a warm, rustic finish that suits any festive home display. It looks lovely on a front door, but also works beautifully indoors on a mantelpiece, sideboard, shelf or as part of a table centrepiece.

This style of wreath pairs well with other natural Christmas decorations, such as wooden ornaments, warm white lights, garlands, candle displays and traditional greenery. The neutral woodland tones make it easy to use with classic red and gold schemes, soft Scandi-inspired styling or simple country Christmas décor.

Display indoors or in a sheltered outdoor position away from heavy rain, strong wind and prolonged damp conditions. When the season is over, gently dust if needed, allow it to dry fully if used outside, then store it in its box in a cool, dry place ready for next Christmas.

Supplied as one 30cm woodland wreath with pinecones, white berries and decorative wooden stars, carefully boxed and ready to display.
NATURAL FESTIVE STYLE: Christmas character and cheer for your home, with a 30cm woodland wreath featuring pinecones, white berries, wooden stars and foliage detail. The rustic finish gives your doors, mantels, shelves and table displays a warm, welcoming look.
READY TO DISPLAY: This wreath arrives already arranged, so there is no wiring, tying or assembly needed. Simply remove from the box and hang or place in your chosen position indoors, or use in a sheltered outdoor spot protected from heavy rain and strong wind.
VERSATILE CHRISTMAS DECOR: Use on a front door, above a fireplace, on a sideboard, in a hallway or laid flat as a table centrepiece. The natural tones work beautifully with classic Christmas decorations, wooden ornaments, garlands, candles and warm white lights.
DETAILS: Supplied as one 30cm woodland wreath with cones, white berries and decorative wooden stars. Unpack carefully on arrival, display indoors or in a sheltered outdoor position, then store dry after Christmas.
ABOUT US: At YouGarden, we believe that gardening is for everyone. Based in rural Lincolnshire, we have our own 11-acre nursery, meaning that we are in close contact with our plants, so that we can guarantee our plants will thrive because we've nurtured them ourselves.

5056747852308.sourceDescription:
These balloons come in a wide variety of vibrant & cheerful colours. These foil balloons are available in vibrant colours that have a colour-popping effect when used for decorating events such as birthdays, anniversaries, and other celebrations.
High-quality foil number balloons, perfect for birthdays, anniversaries and New Year’s Eve parties. This balloon measures 40" (102cm) - please note there may be slight size variations between numbers
The metallic balloons are made from premium-grade foil which is thick and uniformly coloured. Available in a range of beautiful vibrant colours to suit any occasion.
Balloons will arrive uninflated and will need to be inflated using air (reusable inflation tube to blow through included).
Simply insert the reusable inflation tube into the plastic valve at the bottom of the number and slowly blow to inflate. When the balloon is sufficiently inflated, pull out the reusable inflation tube and pinch the self-sealing plastic valve - balloons will stay inflated for days. After the party, please use a plastic reusable inflation tube to export the air for reuse
These balloons are great supplies for birthday parties, weddings, baby showers, outdoor parties, home parties, celebrations and other on-site decorations. A great birthday party decoration for the babies, kids, and adults
Guarantee - 1 month
